visualCharacteristics.structure: h2 + description + "Use the visualizer" pill CTA (eye icon) + room picture
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-bleed band painted with the page color (rgbhex metadata via applyPageColor; light text and inverted pill on dark colors). Mobile/tablet: text, full-width pill, then a 2:3 picture (16px radius), 64px gaps. From 1024px: 12-column grid, text in columns 1-3 (top-aligned, auto-width pill), 3:2 picture in columns 5-12 (24px radius), 104px vertical padding. CTA links to https://www.behr.com/colors/paint/visualizer-landing?colorCode=<color-code metadata>

contentPattern:
row 1: intro (h2 + p; an optional link-only

overrides the CTA label); row 2: picture. The CTA is generated: label "Use the visualizer", href built from the color-code page metadata (bare visualizer URL when missing)
